integrity: All analytical steps, boundary conditions, and independent rational resolvent comparisons are supplied. No empirical or independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two-level Hermitian dynamics, ideal projective probing at independent exponential intervals, nonzero transition coupling. Optimizes only long-time exponential detection-delay tail, not quantiles or hard maximum; no general renewal-clock or imperfect-measurement claim. Earlier published cubic formulas imply the result after additional optimization, presenting a residual implicit-priority risk.
title: Exact tail-optimal random probing of a two-level quantum transition
